subject: ghost-haven
label: Six small rulings
from: Six questions held open, some for weeks
note:
ABBI'S TWO SETS OF TITLES — THE SECOND SET WAS INTENTIONAL AND THEY DO NOT HAVE TO MATCH. The Archive had been treating a duplicate as an error for weeks. A woman may have two sets of three titles and mean both.

SIREN'S WAIST IS TWENTY-SIX. Viraena's ruling, delivered with the observation that Siren is right over there and would not take issue with it.

GHOST HAVEN HAS NO POOL. SPECTER HAVEN DOES.

THE SECOND DONUT WENT WHERE EVERY OTHER DONUT GOES: INTO THE RACCOON. There was never a delivery. There was never a recipient. Eighteen pounds by choice.

NON-FOUND-FAMILY PEOPLE GET A COLLECTION. Approved: Ragnar, James, Marianne, Cassandra, Eden, the twelve Hathaway daughters, the Aglios, Megan, Sable, Sienna, Maya and the rest stop being smuggled into systems.

THE BUST GATE STANDS, AND THE SWEEP WAITS. When the v8 proposal passes on all counts — when the Builds are rebuilt and the other Pillars join — there will be a SWEEPING UPDATE across the girls, and every woman gets to modify whatever she wants modified. The Archive does not touch twenty-nine busts before that day.
